title: 植入式材料生物相容性資料管理
summary: 以「材料批次、接觸類型與試驗報告的證據表」展開10單元、40步，包含機制、合成算例、獨立驗證和「一種材料名稱代表所有添加物與製程」的診斷。
summaryEn: Ten units and forty steps on Evidence linking material lot, contact type and test reports, with mechanisms, synthetic calculations, independent checks and diagnosis of One material name representing all additives and processing.
scope: 五個案例脈絡模型單元加五個明示共通量測方法單元；41類技術方法會重用，395個案例各有獨立焦點與失效情境。數值全部為合成教學假設，來源支持公開原理和方法，不宣稱已查明每個設施的內部規格、完工狀態或現場操作流程。醫療內容僅限數位/惰性台架，不含診療、病人參數或設備操作。
scopeEn: Five case-context model units plus five explicitly shared measurement-method units. Methods recur across 41 technical families, while 395 cases have individual focuses and failure scenarios. All numbers are synthetic teaching assumptions. Sources support public principles/methods, not every facility’s internal specifications, completion status or operations. Biomedical work uses digital/inert benches only, with no treatment, patient settings or device operation.

steps.instructionEn: For Evidence linking material lot, contact type and test reports, use synthetic inputs for Requirement evidence coverage: verified=8 requirements；required=10 requirements. Check dimensions before evaluating 100*verified/required; the independent benchmark is 80 %. Increase verified by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 88 %. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: verified增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 8 %。覆蓋率不是品質機率；任何關鍵需求失敗仍須獨立列出。

steps.title: 單元1｜需求證據覆蓋：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 1 | Requirement evidence coverage: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「材料批次、接觸類型與試驗報告的證據表」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Evidence linking material lot, contact type and test reports with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「材料批次、接觸類型與試驗報告的證據表」設計「需求證據覆蓋」的獨立驗證：以合成需求矩陣找出缺測、失敗與版本不符，三者不得算入通過數。 以匿名合成紀錄回放正常、缺值、重複和版本不符四種情境，核對預期結果。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Evidence linking material lot, contact type and test reports, independently verify Requirement evidence coverage: Find untested, failed and version-mismatched rows in a synthetic matrix and exclude them from passes. Replay anonymous synthetic normal, missing, duplicate and version-mismatch records against expected outcomes. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「一種材料名稱代表所有添加物與製程」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate One material name representing all additives and processing rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 一種材料名稱代表所有添加物與製程；覆蓋率不是品質機率；任何關鍵需求失敗仍須獨立列出。
steps.failureEn: One material name representing all additives and processing; Coverage is not quality probability; critical failures must remain separately visible.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「覆蓋率不是品質機率；任何關鍵需求失敗仍須獨立列出。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Coverage is not quality probability; critical failures must remain separately visible.

steps.instructionEn: For Evidence linking material lot, contact type and test reports, use synthetic inputs for Data storage volume: rate=16000 byte/s；time=60 s. Check dimensions before evaluating rate*time; the independent benchmark is 960000 byte. Increase rate by 10% with other inputs fixed. Predict direction, then recompute to obtain 1056000 byte. Record value, unit and limits separately.
steps.observation: rate增加10%後，結果增加；變化量為 96000 byte。索引、副本、封包和壓縮另列；不可用壓縮前後混合單位。
steps.observationEn: After the 10% input change the result should increase, changing by 96000 byte. Account separately for indexes, replicas, framing and compression; keep bases consistent.
steps.failure: 一種材料名稱代表所有添加物與製程；索引、副本、封包和壓縮另列；不可用壓縮前後混合單位。
steps.failureEn: One material name representing all additives and processing; Account separately for indexes, replicas, framing and compression; keep bases consistent.
steps.check: 原值重算與 960000 byte 相符；10%案例與 1056000 相符（算術相對容差1e-8）。這個容差只驗算術，不是設備驗收標準。
steps.checkEn: Match 960000 byte at baseline and 1056000 after variation within relative arithmetic tolerance 1e-8. This checks arithmetic, not equipment acceptance.

quiz.question: 合成基準的正確結果是哪個（byte）？
quiz.explanation: 按 rate*time 逐項代入，結果為 960000；輸入全部為教學假設。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting into rate*time gives 960000; all inputs are teaching assumptions.

steps.title: 單元2｜資料儲存量：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Data storage volume: Measurement and verification
steps.objective: 以「材料批次、接觸類型與試驗報告的證據表」完成量測與驗證並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete measurement and verification for Evidence linking material lot, contact type and test reports with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 針對「材料批次、接觸類型與試驗報告的證據表」設計「資料儲存量」的獨立驗證：生成固定筆數合成事件，比較實際檔案bytes與公式估計並解釋差額。 以匿名合成紀錄回放正常、缺值、重複和版本不符四種情境，核對預期結果。 製作A基準、B單因子+10%、C遺漏單位或不適用邊界三筆數位測試。A/B可檢算，C必須標示不可判定，不能填成通過。先記預期，再看結果。
steps.instructionEn: For Evidence linking material lot, contact type and test reports, independently verify Data storage volume: Generate a fixed synthetic event count and compare file bytes with the estimate, explaining overhead. Replay anonymous synthetic normal, missing, duplicate and version-mismatch records against expected outcomes. Make A baseline, B one-factor +10%, and C missing-unit/out-of-domain digital cases. A/B are computable; C must be indeterminate, not passed. Record expectations before results.
steps.observation: A與B驗證模型方向和數值，C驗證資料入口；若觀測與模型不符，先核對「一種材料名稱代表所有添加物與製程」的可能性，而非修改資料使其吻合。
steps.observationEn: A/B test direction and value; C tests the data gate. If observation disagrees, investigate One material name representing all additives and processing rather than editing data to fit.
steps.failure: 一種材料名稱代表所有添加物與製程；索引、副本、封包和壓縮另列；不可用壓縮前後混合單位。
steps.failureEn: One material name representing all additives and processing; Account separately for indexes, replicas, framing and compression; keep bases consistent.
steps.check: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「索引、副本、封包和壓縮另列；不可用壓縮前後混合單位。」。
steps.checkEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Account separately for indexes, replicas, framing and compression; keep bases consistent.

quiz.question: 哪一份驗證紀錄可供他人重做？
options: 只保留最後的通過字樣。
把無效輸入刪掉後稱全部通過。
保留原始資料並執行：生成固定筆數合成事件，比較實際檔案bytes與公式估計並解釋差額。
optionsEn: Delete invalid inputs and claim all cases passed.
Retain raw data and perform: Generate a fixed synthetic event count and compare file bytes with the estimate, explaining overhead.
quiz.explanation: 提交A/B/C測試表：原始資料、預期、結果、誤差、版本與判定俱全；C保留為無效輸入，並註記「索引、副本、封包和壓縮另列；不可用壓縮前後混合單位。」。
quiz.explanationEn: Submit A/B/C inputs, expectations, results, errors, version and decisions; retain C as invalid and state Account separately for indexes, replicas, framing and compression; keep bases consistent.

steps.title: 單元2｜資料儲存量：失效診斷與交付
steps.titleEn: Unit 2 | Data storage volume: Diagnosis and deliverable
steps.objective: 以「材料批次、接觸類型與試驗報告的證據表」完成失效診斷與交付並留下可核對證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete diagnosis and deliverable for Evidence linking material lot, contact type and test reports with checkable evidence.
steps.instruction: 本課失效情境是「一種材料名稱代表所有添加物與製程」。以本單元「資料儲存量」的變數表建立兩個競爭解釋：真實工程量改變，以及感測/單位/邊界錯誤。選用「生成固定筆數合成事件，比較實際檔案bytes與公式估計並解釋差額。」作區分證據；記錄哪個觀測會推翻各解釋。最後交付介面圖、基準與敏感度計算、A/B/C測試，以及仍缺的證據。
steps.instructionEn: The case failure is One material name representing all additives and processing. For Data storage volume, compare a real engineering change with a sensing/unit/boundary error. Use Generate a fixed synthetic event count and compare file bytes with the estimate, explaining overhead. to discriminate and state an observation that would refute each explanation. Deliver the diagram, baseline/sensitivity calculations, A/B/C tests and remaining evidence gaps.
steps.observation: 「一種材料名稱代表所有添加物與製程」不是單靠 960000 byte 就能排除；需要對應量測與適用邊界。
steps.observationEn: The number 960000 byte alone cannot exclude One material name representing all additives and processing; matched measurements and applicability boundaries are needed.
steps.failure: 一種材料名稱代表所有添加物與製程；索引、副本、封包和壓縮另列；不可用壓縮前後混合單位。
steps.failureEn: One material name representing all additives and processing; Account separately for indexes, replicas, framing and compression; keep bases consistent.
steps.check: 交付單元2的五項證據包；清楚寫出「材料批次、接觸類型與試驗報告的證據表」中此模型可解釋與不可解釋的部分，並保留失敗案例。
steps.checkEn: Deliver the five-item evidence pack for unit 2, stating what the model can/cannot explain for Evidence linking material lot, contact type and test reports and retaining failed cases.
